user.title: 1 · Choose countries
user.description: Independent community project; not developed, endorsed or affiliated with Hertz. Select the Freerider services you want to watch. Norway and Sweden have working route feeds; Denmark is not ready yet.

route.title: 2 · Choose route
route.description: Choose a station from the suggested places, or type any city or location. Suggestions come from currently published routes, so they may change. Leave either field empty to include all locations.

date.title: 3 · When do you want to travel?
date.description: All dates is the simplest option. Choose a specific day or period if needed; the dates describe Hertz's published offer window, not guaranteed bookable pickup times.

date_window.title: Select travel date(s)
date_window.description: Choose a date or inclusive date range. Your search can be changed later.

error.country_not_ready: Choose Norway or Sweden. The Denmark data source is not ready yet.
error.end_before_start: End date cannot be earlier than start date.

init.title: Manage saved Freerider search
init.description: Change only the part you need. Advanced vehicle options and notification settings stay out of the initial setup.

route.title: Countries and places
route.description: Choose a suggested station or enter any place. Blank means anywhere.

dates.title: Travel dates
dates.description: All dates, one day, or an inclusive date range.

date_window.title: Choose dates
date_window.description: The published offer window may differ from bookable pickup times.

filters.title: Vehicle preferences
filters.description: All filters are optional. Unknown vehicle details are not guessed.

updates.title: Checks and notifications
updates.description: Automatic checks use a configurable interval. New results trigger a Home Assistant event; phone push requires a mobile notification automation.

data.notify_events: Send event for new matching vehicles
